description:

We're excited to hear from you.What You Will Be Responsible For: Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teamsWhat We Are Looking For: 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design. A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered. Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad. Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste. Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships. Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plusSuccess Roadmap:In 30 Days, You'll: Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages. Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences. Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed. Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts. In 60 Days, You'll: Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent. Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages. Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts. Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process In 90 Days, You'll: Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages. Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage. Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.By Your One-Year Anniversary: You will have helped establish Lucyd's post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to: Faster landing page creation and iteration Higher-quality post-click experiences Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the clickApply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

title: Especialista De Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade Também Para Pcd♿
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista De Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade Também Para Pcd♿ em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:   The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.  KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:   Quarterly package review   - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope. - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions. - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process. - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies. - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.  Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.  One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.  OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.  REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).  Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:   Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel);  experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills:  Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities:  Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.  In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

description:
Nova vaga disponível para Scrum Master (Pj) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Qual será o seu papel? O Scrum Master é o líder servidor responsável por estabelecer e sustentar o Scrum conforme definido no Guia do Scrum, além de integrar práticas de Kanban e Lean para otimizar o fluxo de entrega. Em um contexto de mineração, ele atua como o elo de eficiência entre as equipes de desenvolvimento e os desafios operacionais de campo, garantindo que o time supere impedimentos técnicos e culturais na integração de sistemas industriais.Responsabilidades Principais Facilitação e Coach Ágil:Conduzir ritos (Daily, Planning, Review e Retrospective) garantindo o foco em resultados e a melhoria contínua do Time de Desenvolvimento. Agendar, planejar, organizar e conduzir reuniões de planejamento, alinhamento e acompanhamento de projetos. Promover o engajamento de stakeholders e fornecer detalhes a todos os envolvidos nos projetos. Remoção de Impedimentos:Atuar proativamente para eliminar gargalos que afetam a produtividade, especialmente em integrações complexas entre sistemas de TI e ativos de TO (redes industriais, sensores e telemetria). Otimização do Fluxo (Lean/Kanban):Aplicar métricas de fluxo (Lead Time, Cycle Time e Throughput) para identificar desperdícios e aumentar a previsibilidade das entregas. Apoio ao Product Owner:Auxiliar o PO na organização do backlog e na compreensão da agilidade técnica necessária para produtos voltados à operação mineira. Gestão de Mudanças e Cultura:Promover a mentalidade ágil em ambientes tradicionalmente rígidos, facilitando a colaboração entre engenheiros de automação e desenvolvedores de software. Proteção do Time:Blindar a equipe de interferências externas durante a Sprint, garantindo o foco nos compromissos assumidos.Esperamos que você tenha: Formação Superior em Tecnologia. Vivência sólida como Scrum Master em projetos de tecnologia aplicada à indústria ou mineração (ex: Sistemas de Despacho, Automação de Ativos, Dashboards de Operação). Domínio profundo dos frameworks Scrum e Kanban. Conhecimento em princípios Lean Manufacturing/Lean IT (identificação de desperdícios e VSM). Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de ciclo de vida de aplicação (Azure DevOps ou Jira). Noções de integração TI/TO: Entendimento básico de protocolos industriais, sistemas MES e arquiteturas de nuvem para suporte à Indústria 4.0. Certificações (Essenciais): PSM I ou II (Professional Scrum Master) ou CSM (Certified Scrum Master). Certificações (Diferenciais): certificações Lean Six Sigma.Modelo de Contratação: PJ Modalidade de Trabalho: Híbrido

Desenvolver clientes, realizar acompanhamento (follow-up), identificar e classificar consultas de clientes, e executar a manutenção contínua desses contatos. 2. Elaborar cotações para produtos solicitados pelos clientes, acompanhar a demanda dos clientes por produtos, conduzir negociações comerciais, concluir pedidos e monitorar a entrega dos produtos para garantir a qualidade, quantidade, prazo de entrega e modalidade de transporte, conforme os requisitos do cliente. 3. Desenvolver estrategicamente seu território de vendas por meio da aquisição planejada e sistemática de novos clientes, mantendo comunicação e coordenação constantes com os departamentos internos de atendimento e técnico. 4. Manter regularmente um bom serviço de pós-venda e bons relacionamentos com os clientes, via e-mail e telefone, preservando parcerias de cooperação de longo prazo. 5. Motivar e liderar a equipe de vendas, definir objetivos claros, monitorar a evolução do desempenho e fornecer os treinamentos e recursos necessários. 6. Realizar viagens de negócios locais para visitar clientes e participar de diversas feiras e exposições do setor.Perspectivas de Carreira: Engenheiro de Vendas Sênior → Líder de Equipe Comercial → Gerente Regional → Diretor de VendasSistema Remuneratório: Salário base + Comissão + Bônus por Desempenho + Bônus por Projetos + Bônus de Final de AnoRequisitos para a Vaga: 1. Disponibilidade para atuar em escritórios nacionais em diversas partes do mundo. Os países com vagas abertas incluem: Estados Unidos, Japão, Reino Unido, Canadá, Alemanha, Itália, Austrália, Dinamarca, Espanha, França, Coreia do Sul, Brasil e Malásia. (É exigido residir e trabalhar localmente, além de possuir planos de desenvolvimento de longo prazo na região). 2. Possuir conhecimento específico sobre componentes eletrônicos ou sobre a indústria eletrônica, compreendendo as tendências de mercado e as necessidades dos clientes. 3. Experiência na indústria de distribuição de componentes eletrônicos é um diferencial.Benefícios: 1. Desfrutar de feriados nacionais oficiais e benefícios festivos. 2. Os funcionários efetivos terão direito a gratificações por tempo de serviço, férias anuais remuneradas (de até 10 dias) e licença-maternidade remunerada. 3. A empresa organiza viagens anualmente e promove outras atividades periodicamente. 4. Convidamos regularmente profissionais de destaque do setor para treinamentos e aprendizado, além de realizarmos sessões de compartilhamento de experiências de negócios. 5. A empresa participa regularmente de feiras internacionais de eletrônicos todos os anos (nos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Vietnã e Brasil). 6. Oferecemos treinamento remunerado abrangente, incluindo capacitação inicial sobre produtos, métodos comerciais e raciocínio estratégico, organizado em etapas para garantir uma formação sistemática, com orientação individual personalizada (mentoria 1 a 1). 7. O período de experiência inclui o recebimento de comissões, e há dois dias de folga aos finais de semana.Requisitos e Habilidades: 1. Graduação (nível superior) ou formação acadêmica superior;  a área de formação é flexível (preferência para cursos em Engenharia Eletrônica ou Marketing). 2. Boas habilidades de escuta, fala, leitura e escrita;  proficiência no uso do idioma inglês para comunicação e negociação com clientes. 3. Boas habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e execução;  capacidade de resposta rápida e perspicaz;  forte senso de responsabilidade. 4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação. 5. Forte capacidade de aprendizado e espírito de busca por aprendizado contínuo. 6. Aspiração em atuar e paixão pelo setor de comércio exterior e e-commerce. 7. Bom espírito de equipe.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM Location : Campinas, Brazil Role Overview We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1) to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments. This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability. Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2. Key Responsibilities Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior. Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related. Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools. Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts. Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis. Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred. Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations. description:

Olá, futuro(a) PO (Product Owner PL/SR) ! ✨ Estamos em busca de um Product Owner versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas. Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real. Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura): Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por: Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade. Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade. Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades: 1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado) Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document) Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você) Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. Diferencial Competitivo IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. PARA ISSO, OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ TRABALHAR CONOSCO: 01) Salário: A combinar (Enviar pretensão salarial) 02 Segunda a Sexta 03) Horário: 08h às 17h 04) Local de trabalho: Prédio Sky Galleria (no Shopping Galleria), na Cidade de Campinas/SP 05) Regime de trabalho: HÍBRIDO (seguindo os critérios da política interna) 06) Regime de contratação: CLT 07) Plano de carreira 08) Cesta básica R$250,00 09) Vale refeição no total de R$ 32,00/ dia 10) Vale transporte c/ desconto 6%, pago em dinheiro ou Auxilio combustível fixo de R$ 300,00 11) Benefícios de VR, Cesta e Auxilio combustível, pagos através de um cartão unificado e flexível, operadora pela Sólides, para utilização na modalidade de crédito, bandeira Mastercard e que é aceito em uma infinidade de estabelecimentos 12) Convênio Farmácia,que conta com ofertas exclusivas e crédito de R$ 300,00 com desconto em folha de pagamento 13) Confraternizações: última quarta-feira (COFFEE BREAK) do mês 14) Parceria com Instituição de Ensino Anhanguera/Grupo Cogna 15) Descontos em lojas e restaurantes do Galleria Shopping 16) Estacionamento do shopping com valor reduzido, pago mensalmente diretamente à administração Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Ai Development Orchestrator em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;  the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;  the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect featuresas single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;  the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;  quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Delivery Manager
description:

Responsabilidades Acompanhar e garantir a performance dos times alocados no cliente Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à entrega Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos) Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios de performance, KPIs, riscos e indicadores da conta Conduzir processos de onboarding do time (Avenue Code e cliente) Realizar entrevistas com foco em culture fit Conduzir avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks contínuos e reuniões 1:1 Criar e acompanhar planos de desenvolvimento individuais (PDI) Apoiar ações de retenção, promoções, negociações e movimentações internas Controlar horas trabalhadas e apoiar a gestão de capacidade do time Atuar em reuniões de attrition e análise de riscos de turnover Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas Requisitos Inglês avançado ou fluente (excelente comunicação verbal e escrita) Experiência em gestão de pessoas Experiência no relacionamento direto com clientes Background técnico, preferencialmente em desenvolvimento de software Habilidade de negociação Experiência com relatórios de performance e indicadores de negócio Desejáveis Experiência com vendas ou suporte à área comercial Conhecimento em OKRs Experiência com métricas de performance Familiaridade com NPS A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Product Owner em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description:

Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds. Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy: Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição. Qual o desafio? Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados. O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia? A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.Js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos. O que esperamos de você? Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.Js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;  JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Campaign Director

Duration: 1 year Employment type: Independent contractor agreement Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone Reporting to: Senior Director Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST How to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( About the Secure Energy Project The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy. The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash. Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together. Who we’re looking for We’re looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security. You’ll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You’ll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent. To change everything, it takes everyone. That’s why you’ll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You’ll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts. Working closely with the Senior Director, you’ll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates. This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise. We’re looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You’ll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear. What you’ll do Drive narrative change on energy transition Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP’s communications campaigns. Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases. Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences. Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy. Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP’s global networks and coalitions. Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery. Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects. Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what’s working, what’s not, and what that means for our collective impact. Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed. Coordinate partners across SEP’s coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively. Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content. Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions. Media pitching and spokesperson training Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople. Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities. Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities. Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces. Strategic support and special projects Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we’re developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications. About you: You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches. You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. You think strategically and you can also get things done. You’re extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. You're proactive - you don’t wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. You don’t shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you’ve made mistakes. You have a good sense of humour, you don’t take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills. You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying. Essential skills and experience 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector. A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change. Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content. Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge. Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies. Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment. Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it’s not essential. What we offer A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process. The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation. A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn. Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies. Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy. Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience. How to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( Deadline June 1st 9am BST

description:
Empresa está contratando Especialista De Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade Também Para Pcd em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad. KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Quarterly package review - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope. - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions. - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process. - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies. - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region. Group analyses - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators. One-off items - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data. OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS: The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable. REQUIREMENTS: Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics: Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel);  experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills: Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities: Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning. In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Support Specialist em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting company from Silicon Valley or New York, 100% remotely?We are looking for multi-skilled candidates with excellent interpersonal and technical skills for the position of Technical Support Specialist. The ideal candidate will focus on customer success and data fluency, troubleshooting technical issues related to Snowflake, APIs, and large-scale data delivery, rather than traditional IT or desktop support. You will work cross-functionally with Account Managers, Data Fulfillment teams, and Data Engineers to investigate technical issues, document findings clearly, and keep customers proactively informed throughout the resolution process. This role offers the opportunity to directly impact customer satisfaction and operational excellence, working closely with both technical and customer-facing teams in a dynamic, data-driven company. The salary range is $1,800 USD to $2,400 USD per month, depending on the candidate's experience and seniority.  Responsibilities: -Provide front-line technical support for customer issues related to: Data delivery and ingestion. API integrations and troubleshooting. Account and data management.  -Investigate and troubleshoot technical issues, reproducing customer errors when possible, focusing on root cause analysis. -Validate large datasets, identifying inconsistencies or errors through SQL queries. -Proactively communicate updates and resolution progress to customers in a clear, professional manner. -Collaborate with data quality, engineering, and product teams to improve processes, tools, and product stability. -Maintain accurate case records to measure and improve CSAT, response times, and resolution times. -Identify recurring themes and translate them into repeatable, scalable solutions. -Ensure adherence to SLAs while driving timely resolutions.  Requirements: Fluent in English YOU MUST BE ABLE TO HAVE A FLUENT PROFESSIONAL CONVERSATION IN ENGLISH. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field, OR equivalent practical experience in data troubleshooting, support, and integration. 2-4 years of experience in technical support, data operations, or customer experience roles. SQL querying in Snowflake (filtering, joins, sampling for validation). API troubleshooting (REST, error codes, authentication, Postman usage). Familiarity with bulk data delivery (SFTP, AWS S3, CSV/JSON/XML handling). Data validation and troubleshooting by comparing datasets to detect inconsistencies. Understanding of data ingestion flows (data movement into CRMs, data warehouses, or BI tools). Strong communication skills (written and verbal), able to translate technical issues into customer-friendly updates. Ownership mindset, taking accountability and driving issues through to resolution. Highly collaborative and proactive, with a strong focus on problem-solving and continuous improvement.

You thrive in a startup environment: strong sense of ownership, ability to manage ambiguity, and a team-oriented mindset. You work independently and in an organized manner, prioritizing tasks with the greatest impact. Bonus: Experience in hospitality, property management, or proptech;  familiarity with Airbnband similar platforms;  proficiency with CRM tools (Monday.Com);  being bilingual in English/Italian is considered a plus. If you agree with the compensation of $1,000–$1,500/month If you have a bachelors degree related. If you agree with the next schedule split:  This role has a non-standard schedule. Its on EST timezone, so please consider the time difference from your country.( You will work a split shift: — Morning block: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM ET — Evening block: 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM ET — 5 days out of 7, on a rotating basis that includes weekends and holidays This schedule is fixed and non-negotiable. If you need a standard 9–5 Monday–Friday schedule, this is not the right fit right now. Why Join Us? This is more than a customer support role — it's a chance to be a founding pillar of the guest experience at an exciting startup that's transforming the way people discover rural travel. You'll have real ownership over your work, the freedom to innovate, and the opportunity to grow alongside a passionate, mission-driven team. title: Consultor(a) de implantação (são paulo e região) - transformação digital (3)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Consultor(a) de implantação (são paulo e região) - transformação digital (3) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

E se o seu trabalho ajudasse cidades inteiras a tomar decisões melhores? Na IPM, acreditamos que tecnologia só faz sentido quando melhora a vida das pessoas. Por isso, desenvolvemos soluções em nuvem com Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à gestão pública, capazes de transformar dados em decisões mais inteligentes para áreas essenciais como saúde, educação, contabilidade e planejamento urbano. Somos uma GovTech brasileira que atua diariamente ao lado de centenas de municípios, antecipando problemas, simplificando processos e ajudando gestores públicos a cuidar melhor das cidades e das pessoas. Aqui, inovação não é discurso: é impacto real, mensurável e em escala. Trabalhar na IPM é fazer parte de um time que acredita no poder da tecnologia para mudar realidades, assumir grandes desafios e construir, todos os dias, o futuro da gestão pública. Se você busca propósito, inovação e a chance de deixar sua marca em algo que realmente importa, o seu lugar pode ser aqui. Nessa vaga, seu desafio será: Implementar o conjunto de soluções em Transformação Digital da IPM nos órgãos públicos municipais, seguindo as regras de negócio e as necessidades do cliente. Ministrar treinamento aos novos usuários, observando as suas atribuições; Conferir os resultados da migração e configurações realizadas, corrigindo-as ou complementando-as se necessário com a participação do cliente; Prestar atendimento ao cliente/usuário durante a implantação do sistema, orientando-o para a operação adequada do sistema; Acompanhar o processo de implantação, solucionando problemas e esclarecendo dúvidas.   Requisitos: Para essa posição, você vai precisar de: Ensino superior concluído em Administração, Sistemas da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;  Conhecimento em legislação e normas públicas aplicáveis a área de atuação;   Conhecimento em Softwares de Administração Pública;   Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.   Você vai se destacar se tiver: Experiência no uso de sistemas de gestão pública, portal da transparência, etc.   Benefícios Benefícios que nosso time mais gosta:  Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação (R$35 por dia de trabalho, em torno de R$735 ao mês) no cartão de benefícios flexível Caju; Vale Transporte; Wellhub (antigo Gympass) - acesso livre a mais de 50 mil academias pelo Brasil;Conexa Saúde - plataforma completa de telemecidina, com uma consulta de pronto atendimento e uma consulta com psicólogo gratuita por mês; Guapeco - Plano de Saúde para o seu Pet! IPM Birthday - R$150,00 no Caju com saldo livre, para tornar o dia do seu aniversário ainda mais especial; IPM Indica - indicou um profissional, ele(a) passou no processo seletivo e ficou, pelo menos, 45 dias na empresa, você recebe o valor de R$ 500,00 de bonificação pela indicação; Desconto em plano de saúde da Unimed e odontológico da Uniodonto; Reconhece IPM - nosso reconhecimento financeiro por tempo de casa, investindo e buscando a construção de uma carreira duradoura conosco; Rede de convênios para descontos, incluindo farmácias e restaurantes; Comemoração de datas festivas a cada mês - Carnaval, Festa Junina, Halloween, etc; Dress code flexível - na nossa Sede e Centro de Tecnologia, você pode vir trabalhar de bermuda e camiseta. Importante: Todas as nossas posições são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PCD). Se os seus conhecimentos forem adequados à vaga, é tudo o que importa. Na IPM, nós abraçamos a diversidade e contratamos pessoas com capacidade e vontade de transformar, de construir um futuro melhor para a sociedade, independente de qual seja a sua idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou formação. Seu perfil e valores casam com os nossos? Então venha fazer parte!

Trabalhar no levantamento de requisitos, concepção, e projeto de sistemas eletromagnéticos de radiofrequência (RF), tais como cavidades ressonantes, acopladores, guias de onda, cargas de RF, componentes de transição e subsistemas associados, com foco em aplicações para aceleradores de partículas e instrumentação biomédica;  Atuar na análise eletromagnética de estruturas e componentes de RF, fazendo uso de teoria de eletromagnetismo aplicada, com foco na área de aceleradores de partículas e instrumentação biomédica;  Executar simulações computacionais para análise, projeto e otimização de sistemas de RF utilizando, principalmente, métodos de elementos finitos;  Propor modelagens físicas para análises de sistemas de radiofrequência e implementá-las computacionalmente por meio de ferramentas de programação de alto nível, como Python;  Participar da montagem, instalação e comissionamento de componentes e sistemas de radiofrequência;  Planejar e executar a caracterização em radiofrequência de componentes e estruturas eletromagnéticos, incluindo operação de instrumentação dedicada, como analisadores de espectro e vetoriais de rede;  Interagir com comunidades internacionais na área de radiofrequência e aceleradores de partículas;  Elaborar documentação técnica de projetos;  Dar suporte e orientar integrantes da equipe na área de projeto de sistemas eletromagnéticos em radiofrequência, atuando como referência técnica na área;  Apoiar a gestão de projetos no contexto da equipe e da Unidade de Tecnologia do CNPEM.

title: Desenvolvedor packaging fotonico pl
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Desenvolvedor packaging fotonico pl em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

JOB MISSION   HwIT is seeking a Packaging  Product Development Engineer focused on optical commutations products. You will be a key technical contributor supporting the hardware lifecycle of our photonic modules  from assisting in mechanical/thermal simulations and 3D CAD design to the execution, validation, and optimization of cleanroom packaging processes.  Your main focus will be a hands-on environment bridging RD design with manufacturing reality: supporting multiphysics simulations, detailing micro-assemblies, executing DOEs (Design of Experiments) for method validation, and technically investigating root causes to ensure structural integrity and maximize yield in global scale production.   SCOPE  RESPONSIBILITIES   1. Product Development and Validation  ·       Mechanical  Optomechanical Design for Packaging: Develop 3D CAD models and detailed 2D manufacturing drawings for high-precision optoelectronic packages, test fixtures, and structural assemblies, applying GDT standards.  ·       Multiphysics  Thermal Simulation: Conduct Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to simulate thermal dissipation, mechanical stress, and structural integrity of photonic modules.  ·       Prototyping  Design Validation: Support the rapid prototyping phase and work closely with the Reliability testing team to validate simulation models against empirical data from testing (e.g., Telcordia GR-468, MIL-STD).  2. Process Development and Validation  ·       Critical Parameter Optimization: Assist in defining and optimizing critical process parameters such as die attach (e.g., conductive epoxies, eutectic soldering), wire bonding, and optical alignment.  ·       Encapsulation Techniques: Develop hermetic and semi-hermetic encapsulation techniques for photonic modules.  ·       Material Qualification: Validate new materials, adhesives, and sealing processes according to high-reliability standards.  3. Yield Optimization and Troubleshooting  ·       Root Cause Investigation: Run investigative activities in cleanroom processes to detect the root cause of issues affecting the yield and assembly times of photonic components.  ·       Design of Experiments (DOE): Run DOEs to characterize processes, define critical variables, and find the best assembly recipes.  ·       SPC Alignment: Validate and approve operational methods and process parameters consistent with the Statistical Process Control (SPC) required by Product Engineering.            4. NPI Integration and Manufacturability  ·       Design for Manufacturing (DFM): Execute DFM and development activities in packaging components under senior guidance, promoting technical alignment between suppliers and developers, and evaluating the technical feasibility of new components.  ·       Team Training: Documentation and training the operational team in the meticulous execution of complex encapsulation recipes and methodologies;  ·       Process Transference: Collaborate side-by-side with Product Engineers and Senior Packaging Engineers to validate assemblies and transfer packaging assembly processes to high-volume manufacturing sites.   CANDIDATE PROFILE   Education  Background  Essential:  ·       Bachelor s Degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, or related fields.  ·       Minimum of 25 years of solid experience in microelectronic or optoelectronic packaging processes.  ·       Knowledge of structural adhesives, precision soldering, and interconnect metallurgy.  ·       Familiarity with failure analysis methodologies (SEM, EDS, X-Ray, Cross-section).  ·       Experience in optomechanical design, precision mechanics, or electronic hardware packaging.  ·       Proficiency in 3D CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor) and understanding of GDT.  ·       Track record participating in thermal and structural simulations using tools like ANSYS, COMSOL, or SolidWorks Simulation.  Desirable:  ·       Experience with PICs (Photonic Integrated Circuits) and fiber-to-chip interfaces.  ·       Knowledge of reliability standards (MIL-STD-883, Telcordia GR-468, or NASA EEE-INST-002).  ·       Experience with continuous improvement tools (Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing).  ·       Knowledge of automation programming in Python, C#, or LabVIEW.  ·       Experience designing complex hermetic packages (e.g., Butterfly, TO-can) and managing micro-assembly tolerances.  ·       Background in designing customized mechanical fixtures for High-Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) and environmental testing.  Languages  ·       Portuguese: Native;   ·       English: Mandatory  Advanced/Fluent (B2/C1 level) for day-to-day communication with international partners.  ·       Spanish: Desirable.

Boa comunicação      Principais Responsabilidades:   Manutenção Preventiva e Corretiva:  Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em toda linha de equipamentos Mecalor.  Diagnosticar falhas e propor soluções eficazes para otimizar o desempenho dos equipamentos.  Substituir componentes como compressores, válvulas de expansão, sensores, entre outros.  Diagnóstico e Solução de Problemas:  Realizar testes e medições para identificar falhas mecânicas, elétricas e de automação.  Efetuar ajustes operacionais para garantir a eficiência dos sistemas de refrigeração.  Aplicar procedimentos para otimização do consumo energético dos equipamentos.  Atuar na correção da falhas.  Registro e Relatórios Técnicos:  Documentar os serviços executados em formulários e sistemas internos.  Elaborar relatórios detalhados sobre falhas encontradas e recomendações de melhorias.  Comunicar à supervisão sobre possíveis intervenções que impactem a continuidade operacional. Participar da implementação de novas tecnologias e métodos de manutenção.  Segurança e Conformidade:  Assegurar que todas as intervenções sejam realizadas conforme as normas técnicas e de segurança.  Trabalhar de acordo com regulamentos ambientais e normas para manuseio de gases refrigerantes.  Garantir o correto uso de EPIs e a organização dos materiais e ferramentas.  Treinamento e Desenvolvimento:  Atuar no treinamento e orientação de técnicos juniores e auxiliares.  Buscar aprimoramento contínuo por meio de treinamentos técnicos e certificações.    Necessario disponibilidade para viagens curtas.
